entities.Section: Sub-part of a document defining a topic
entities.Requirement: Condition that must be met by either party
entities.Customer: Individual purchasing or using a product
entities.Product: Item or service offered for sale
entities.Feature: Descriptive attribute of a product or service
entities.Return: Process of sending back a purchased product
entities.Refund: Reimbursement issued after a return or complaint
entities.Review: Customer feedback on products or services
entities.Security Measure: Step taken to protect data or systems
entities.Promotion: Offer to increase product appeal or reduce price
entities.Tax: Mandatory financial charge applied to a sale
entities.Warranty: Guarantee of repair or replacement within a period
entities.Account: Registered user profile on the platform
entities.Transaction: Record of a completed exchange of value

relations.has_section: Indicates a hierarchical section in the document
relations.applies_to: Indicates the subject to which a rule applies
relations.offers_feature: Indicates features associated with a product or service
relations.grants_refund: Indicates that a refund is issued under certain conditions
relations.covers_shipping: Indicates areas or options available for delivery
relations.writes_review: Associates review with customer and product
relations.processes_data: Indicates handling of personal or transaction data
relations.includes_promotion: Refers to active discounts or offers
relations.charges_tax: Applies financial tax on product or transaction
relations.includes_warranty: Associates product or service with a warranty
relations.owns_account: Links customer to their digital identity
